title: Exploded bolted steel shear connection
description: Reusable SVG assembly component showing a support face, shear plate, beam web, and vertical bolt group with explicit geometric fit checks.
learningObjectives: Identify the parts and geometric relationships of a simple bolted shear-plate connection without conflating assembly geometry with connection strength design.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat repository contribution; no third-party visual assets or runtime dependencies.

verification.notes: Candidate includes deterministic bolt-group geometry checks and explicitly excludes strength/code verification. Independent engineering, browser, screenshot, and accessibility review remain required.

source.reference: Reserved structures-agent task str-steel-connection; original dependency-free SVG/DOM implementation.
